summary: Firefox substantially modernized Web Speech by moving recognition on-device with the Parakeet engine and local downloadable models, rather than relying on the former online-recognition path. The Web Speech API now supports continuous recognition, locale-aware model selection, streaming confidence and timing events, punctuation information, and more complete permission and model-download flows, including progress reporting and AI Controls integration. Extensive telemetry, performance counters, memory reporting, profiler markers, and race-condition tests make the feature measurable and more robust, while permission policies help users control when speech data is processed locally.
